verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud's pricing page states it 'supports unlimited concurrency' and offers different agent profiles for compute needs. That speaks directly to scaling without capacity requests, but it is a single marketing-level line with no detailed limits documentation or hands-on scale evidence. Missing for 10: documented per-account concurrency or rate limits and session-start quotas, autoscaling/warm-capacity behavior docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of many simultaneous calls.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented concurrency limits and scale to many simultaneous calls without manual capacity begging

citations.quote: Pipecat Cloud offers different agent profiles, to best support your use case and compute needs.
